title: Long-term care financing program; establishment.
bodyText: There is established the long-term care financing program, which shall be placed with the department of budget and finance for administrative purposes. The purpose of this program shall be to provide a universal and affordable system of providing for long-term care. The program shall be administered by a board of trustees.
bodyHtml: [§346C-2]  Long-term care financing program; establishment.  There is established the long-term care financing program, which shall be placed with the department of budget and finance for administrative purposes.  The purpose of this program shall be to provide a universal and affordable system of providing for long-term care.  The program shall be administered by a board of trustees. [L 2002, c 245, pt of §2]
